finishing.about: The studio pass of the release build (scripts/kilfane_studio.py, called from scripts/build_candidate.py), in font units on the finished traces. The traces are unchanged.
finishing.heights_reason: Judged. The prints set letters of one row up to two source pixels (about 12 units) above or below one another (N516's x-height letters measure 489 to 523 units, its flat capitals 687 to 716), and the production sheet's H, F and D sit up to 19 units under its K and L. In a font these read as letters jumping off the line. Each listed letter is scaled about its baseline so that its flat tops (serifs, bars) meet the line and its round or domed tops the overshoot; the rest of the letter keeps its proportions, and what the prints show as drawn (o's and O's tall tilted ovals, the r's high bowl, the flags of t, T, D.alt1 and S.alt1, X's raised accent, the short descenders of f and j) keeps its height above its own line.
finishing.stems_reason: Noise. At N516's resolution a source pixel is about 6 units, and the straight stems measured 108 to 119 units (lowercase) and 121 to 139 (capitals) at random, with no pattern a pen or a drawing hand would make. Each is given the face's mean weight by moving its two edges apart or together, by at most 3 units each, so the letters' widths and joins stay where the prints put them.

settle.reason: Noise (fourth pass). Rounding the sheared outlines to whole units turned the short handles at stem and arch joins by about the slope (the Italic m's joins 8 to 11 degrees, the n's and h's 8), and the uprights kept joins their finishing could not turn within its tolerance (the Bold's section 6 to 10 degrees): 425 Italic and 432 Bold Italic glyphs had a near-smooth join (a curve on one side, bending 2 to 12 degrees once the slope is sheared off) left bent, 201 Regular and 338 Bold. Last of all, in every style, each such join is made smooth: its handles turned to the join's tangent on whole units (as settle.py settles Carrick's), each curve within 1.5 units, or else the curves either side drawn again on whole-unit handles leaving the join along that tangent, within 2, or a piece under 12 units beside it drawn as one curve with its neighbour; no curve may come to pass an extreme, a join the slope brings under 12 degrees from a corner of the upright stays a corner, and a glyph whose pieces or area would change is left as it was.
